messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

Starting at 09:00, I've got 5 hours and 55 minutes to spend. My budget is S$72. I definitely need to see Supertree Grove, Haw Par Villa and Singapore Cable Car. If there's time, I'd also like National Gallery Singapore, Bird Paradise, Universal Studios Singapore, National Orchid Garden, ArtScience Museum and National Museum of Singapore. I want to do Singapore Cable Car before Haw Par Villa.

response: Got 5 hours and 55 minutes starting at 09:00, and my budget is S$72.
